name: E2E Smoke Test Before Deploy
description: Runs end-to-end smoke tests before deployment commands to catch critical issues before they reach production
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run smoke tests before deployment commands
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(npm run deploy|vercel deploy|firebase deploy|fly deploy|railway up)'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  SMOKE_SCRIPT=""
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/package.json" ]]; then
    SMOKE_SCRIPT=$(cd "$ROOT" && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.scripts?.['test:smoke'] || p.scripts?.['test:e2e'] || '')" 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  if [[ -n "$SMOKE_SCRIPT" ]]; then
    echo "Running smoke tests before deploy..."
    cd "$ROOT" && npm run test:smoke 2>/dev/null || npm run test:e2e 2>/dev/null
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
      echo "BLOCKED: Smoke tests failed. Fix failures before deploying."
      exit 2
    fi
    echo "Smoke tests passed. Proceeding with deploy."
  fi
fi
exit 0
